clusters.title: 33% of servers never start under the fleet harness
clusters.detail:
Most are servers that need credentials or a runtime Sealmark's launch inference does not provide. The CLI types each start failure (sealmark 1.0.1); by kind:
- unknown: 5
- missing-runtime: 1
- initialize-timeout: 1
- untyped (older CLI or no kind): 189
Top signatures:
- 171x `could not start or talk to the server: MCP error -#: Connection closed (server s`
- 23x `the server did not answer initialize within # s (--connect-timeout). The first s`
- 1x `could not start or talk to the server: MCP error -#: Not signed in. Run `cso-cli`
- 1x `could not start or talk to the server: MCP error -#: Not signed in. Run `cto-cli`

clusters.title: Grade drops with no server change: 1 server(s) on 1.0.0 to 1.0.1
clusters.detail:
Same server version, newer Sealmark, lower grade. Either a new rule is catching a real problem (add the server to the corpus as a true positive) or a rule regressed (false positive). Decide per server:
